objects.query: SELECT CustomDecompositionScope, DecompositionScope, FulfillmentQtyCalcMethod, IsActive, Name, StockKeepingUnit FROM Product2 WHERE StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC

SELECT DestinationProductId, Id, Name, Priority, SourceProductId, SourceProductClassificationId, SourceProduct.StockKeepingUnit, SourceProductClassification.Name, DestinationProduct.StockKeepingUnit FROM ProductFulfillmentDecompRule WHERE Name LIKE 'VEL %' ORDER BY SourceProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, DestinationProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT Id, Name, UsageType FROM FulfillmentStepDefinitionGroup WHERE Name LIKE 'VEL %'
SELECT Id, Name FROM Group WHERE Type = 'Queue'

SELECT AssignedToId$User, CustomBaseExecutionDate, CustomFulfillmentScope, DelayUnit, DelayOf, ExecuteOn, FlowDefinitionName, ForcePlanFreezeDuringExecution, StepDefinitionGroupId, AmendGroupId, CancelledGroupId, IntegrationDefinitionNameId, Id, Name, OmniscriptName, PointOfNoReturn, ResumeOnRuleId, Scope, IsSkipBranch, TaskAllocationType, StepType, UsageType FROM FulfillmentStepDefinition WHERE Name LIKE 'VEL %'

SELECT DependencyScope, IsCompensateInReverse, FulfillmentStepDefinitionId, DependsOnStepDefinitionId, Id, Name, PropagateStateToDependentStep FROM FulfillmentStepDependencyDef WHERE Name LIKE 'VEL %'

SELECT Action, FulfillmentProcessId, FulfillmentStepDefnGroupId, ProductClassificationId, Name, Id, ProductId, SourceClassIdentifier, SourceIdentifier, Type FROM ProductFulfillmentScenario WHERE Name LIKE 'VEL %'
SELECT Description, Id, Name FROM FulfillmentWorkspace WHERE Name = 'Velantis Machine Fulfillment'

SELECT FulfillmentStepDefinitionGroupId, FulfillmentWorkspaceId, FulfillmentWorkspace.Name, FulfillmentStepDefinitionGroup.Name, Id, ShowOrder FROM FulfillmentWorkspaceItem WHERE FulfillmentWorkspace.Name = 'Velantis Machine Fulfillment'
SELECT ErrorCode, FlowDefinitionName, Id, StepType, FalloutQueueId, IntegrationDefinitionId, Name, RetriesAllowed, RetryIntervals, RetryPolicy FROM FulfillmentFalloutRule WHERE Name LIKE 'VEL-%'

SELECT EstimatedDuration, EstimatedDurationUnit, FlowDefinition, Id, StepType, JeopardyThreshold, JeopardyThresholdUnit, Name, IntegrationDefinition.DeveloperName FROM FulfillmentStepJeopardyRule WHERE Name LIKE 'VEL-%'
SELECT ConditionId, DestinationId, Id, Name, Priority, SourceId, TaskAllocationType FROM FulfillmentTaskAssignmentRule WHERE Name LIKE 'VEL-%'
